descriptive_statistics.objective: Compute and interpret mean, median, mode, variance, standard deviation, and percentiles for a dataset.

data_visualization.objective: Select appropriate chart types (histogram, boxplot, scatter plot, bar chart) and create them using matplotlib/seaborn.

probability_basics.objective: Apply rules of probability, conditional probability, and Bayes' theorem to simple events.

distributions.objective: Identify and apply the normal, binomial, and Poisson distributions; use z-scores and the central limit theorem.

hypothesis_testing.objective: Formulate null and alternative hypotheses; apply t-tests and chi-squared tests; interpret p-values and Type I/II errors.

correlation_regression.objective: Compute Pearson/Spearman correlation; fit and interpret a simple linear regression model; distinguish correlation from causation.

pandas_basics.objective: Load, inspect, filter, group, and aggregate tabular data using pandas DataFrames and Series.

data_cleaning.objective: Identify and handle missing values, outliers, and duplicate records; encode categorical variables.

exploratory_data_analysis.objective: Conduct a systematic EDA: summarize distributions, identify relationships, and document findings with annotated plots.

statistical_reporting.objective: Present statistical results clearly: report effect sizes, confidence intervals, and interpret findings in plain language.

notes: 10-topic Data Analysis domain for the curric-agents pilot study.
